headline: MIA @ NYM matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIA 3.46 at NYM 2.51, with a projected total of 5.96. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIA: MIA moved -0.84 runs while NYM moved -2.39, changing the projected margin by +1.54 runs. The projected total fell -3.23, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +11.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Max Meyer has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Juan Soto, Xavier Edwards, Otto Lopez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags MJ Melendez, Esteury Ruiz because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
